original.statement: The storage version of the ImageRepository CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing objects need a storage version migration and status.storedVersions must be updated before a later release removes v1beta2.

decision.reason: The change text, a computed CRD storage diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml files [ev-782bc47d120d, ev-c2c6c790d6b2], says existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten. On an upgrade, any environment with ImageRepository objects needs the migration, whether its manifests use v1beta2 or v1. So the proposed condition, any of gvk-in-use ImageRepository at v1beta2 or v1, captures the exposed environments. The excerpts themselves contain almost nothing and actual storage state isn't visible statically, so confidence is low.
